subject.title: Telegram /reasoning stream can leave replies stuck after send_attempt_started and chat.history burst

question: Should this stay as distinct Telegram `/reasoning stream` plus `chat.history` recovery work, or be folded into the broader ambiguous-send and guarded-lane recovery work?
rationale: Source evidence supports a shared ambiguous-send recovery gap, but this report adds a reasoning-preview trigger and Control UI history pressure that the existing related issue and open PRs do not fully own.

options.title: Track Distinct Reasoning/History Work
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical place to prove and fix reasoning preview/final delivery plus any confirmed `chat.history` backpressure.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Recovery
options.body: Track the remaining delivery behavior through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/91456 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87544 if maintainers consider reasoning/history symptoms secondary.

options.title: Split UI History Separately
options.body: Use this issue for Telegram ambiguous-send recovery and create or select a separate canonical item for `chat.history` latency if it proves independent.

recommendation.title: Track Distinct Reasoning/History Work
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical place to prove and fix reasoning preview/final delivery plus any confirmed `chat.history` backpressure.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses durable outbound recovery semantics, Telegram reconnect behavior, and operator-visible delivery consistency where this ownership history is strongest.
